performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; 11-day purchase drought confirms fatigue, not noise.

findings.text: ROAS fell 60.32% week-over-week to 3.6 blended; last 3 days (Aug 21–23) show 0 purchases vs 2 purchases in prior 3 days (Aug 18–20) — collapse is accelerating.
Zero purchases recorded Aug 13–23 (11 straight days) on flat ~$54/day spend; revenue has run dry while ad dollars continue flowing — confirmed efficiency crisis.
Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 (due 2026-08-14) has no completed event match — 10 days overdue; fresh real-footage creative supply is blocked at the source.
IG reach fell 19.72% week-over-week (last 3 days avg 654 vs prior 3-day avg 803); combined with rising frequency history, creative fatigue is the most likely driver of purchase collapse.
GBP actions dropped 21.93% week-over-week; last 2 days in series are both zero — possible data gap, but organic intent signal is softening alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Inject at least 2 new product-creative variants into BWS - Sales - Muslims immediately; existing creatives have driven 11 zero-purchase days.
suggestions.monday_update: BWS - Sales - Muslims has posted zero purchases across 11 consecutive days (Aug 13–23) at ~$54/day spend, with IG reach down 19.72% — a confirmed fatigue signal. Pull at least 2 new product-creative variants from the approved stock-footage or facility-footage library (Haney Drive folders, Jul 21) into this campaign immediately. Success check: any purchase registered within 5 days of new creative going live (by 2026-08-29). If zero purchases by Aug 29, escalate to budget pause.

suggestions.text: Hold budget flat at ~$54/day; do not scale BWS - Sales - Muslims until new creative posts at least 1 purchase — ROAS floor is the gate.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day ROAS sits at 3.6 and is falling (-60.32% week-over-week); scaling into a zero-purchase streak risks burning budget with no return. Keep daily Meta spend at current ~$54/day. Re-check on 2026-08-27: if new creative (S1) has not produced a purchase by then, bring Sohib a pause recommendation for the top campaign ($844.26 of $1,495.29 total).
